svg.title: Aura Marketplace production runtime map
svg.desc: Layered production map. Clients load one static storefront release from six public hosts. Vercel, Netlify, and Render proxy same-origin API paths to the CloudFront edge; the AWS CloudFront host is that edge. Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages call it directly with CORS. The edge verifies its origin secret and forwards to Caddy on one EC2 host, which runs the API and worker from one immutable image with Redis on a private Compose network. The API and worker use MongoDB, S3 uploads, Parameter Store secrets, and external providers. The production assistant is deterministic and runs without an LLM. A separate static gateway only links to storefronts and verified downloads. The release path runs pull-request gates, main gates, a manual production confirmation, an immutable image build, an OIDC and SSM deploy, and a health probe with automatic restore.
svg.text: One storefront release · six public hosts · one shared API + worker runtime
